messages:
alex-chen: Hey team, day 3 here. Trying to map who to ping for ownership questions 1: model ingestion jobs, 2: serving infra, 3: runbooks/escalation. Any quick cheat-sheet?

rohan: welcome! TL;DR: ingestion = eng-platform, serving runtime = eng-runtime, runbooks/oncall = eng-sre.

alex-chen: thanks. specific channels or folks to DM if Im lost?

rohan: channels: #eng-platform, #eng-runtime, #eng-sre. For people: @maria-p handles platform ownership, @eva is runtime lead. If it's urgent, page the SRE rotation via PagerDuty.

eva: quick note: runtime owns model-serving binary, autoscaling, and kernel flags. We dont own data-formatting so dont send ingestion bug reports to runtime.

alex-chen: good to know. If inference latency spikes in prod, outline of steps?

maria-p: quick playbook: 1) check /metrics and the dashboard (latency, 5xx rate) 2) check recent deploys in #deploys 3) curl health endpoints + k8s pods 4) if SLO > breach threshold, page SRE. We have a short checklist in infra/runbooks/model-latency.md

sre-bot: PagerDuty alert created: PD-5521 1 - latency_slo_breach -> paging eng-sre rotation. (Link in #incidents)

alex-chen: if SRE doesn't ack, whos next? escalation chain?

rohan: pager escalates automatically: oncall -> sre-lead -> eng-platform lead -> product director. Times are in the runbook. If you cant find it, DM me and Ill drop the link.

maria-p: also check the ownership matrix in the handbook under "service-owners.md" - lists primary + secondary owners for each service so you know who to CC.

alex-chen: do dev/staging incidents follow the same flow? or is there a different owner for retry/backoff config?

maria-p: dev/staging config changes are PRs against eng-platform. For quick experiments ping me or open a ticket in #eng-platform and tag the `platform-oncall` rotation.

eva: small tip: include request-id and model-version in your bug reports. That speeds triage.

alex-chen: Amazing, this is super helpful. Ill add the runbook links to the handbook where I noticed missing pointers. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
